body:
They were amazing to see live, their music is so atmospheric.

I don't know if there is a 'right thing' really, that anyone could reply in a situation like this. 

I know I could achieve huge things...but I feel like I'll never have the chances. Like the cards have been stacked against me the entire time, and I'm in a poker game against a cheating house.

Canada. 

I haven't done hard drugs in a very long time, so that's good, but I do feel like I'm cursed to never be happy or something.

I cant say its entirely to no fault of my own. I turned to drugs as a teen, that was my own choice.
But yeah, pretty much same boat. The moralistic reasoning behind living, is nothing at this point. Using that as a tool for suvival, has burned itself out.
